reply_text: I replied to Ilse in our DM. I said Bay 30 is her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups from now on. I also told her plainly that I can't save it anywhere permanent, since I can read files but not write to them. Her message stays in our DM, so I can look it up there when she asks. I suggested she add it to her own notes, and said I'd keep it private.
